supersedes: mask_filter_v1 (kept unchanged; v1/v2-placement results stay in the report as the reason for v2)
scope: Diffusion-internal stage-1 mask filter. Does not change shared QC.
derived_from: v1 rules: mask_probe_v2 (screw+thread_side). New latent rule: support_latent_cells.py on the frozen support masks (train split only) + the generation mechanism (ddpm.log_images resizes the mask to 32x32 and thresholds at 0.5; DDIM keeps the original latent outside it).

area_window.basis: support mask areas at 256x256 (computed per defect type from the frozen support list)

min_latent_cells.rule: after placement, cells of torchvision Resize((32,32))(mask) >= 0.5 must be >= max(floor, min latent cells over the support masks of this defect type)
min_latent_cells.floor_reason: a 1-cell latent mask is smoothed away: in v1+v2 test runs 0/9 samples with <=1 cell had visibility ratio > 2 (observation on generated samples; disclosed as such)

binarise: mean over RGB of samples_scaled > 0.8 (upstream rule, unchanged)
